theme_archetype.description: A very approachable, friendly, and non-intimidating design for non-technical Latino contractors. Uses generous spacing, clear high-contrast typography, and a trustworthy primary color.

layout_strategy.core_principle: Progressive Disclosure (Divulgación progresiva). Hide advanced complexity inside accordions or 'Advanced Options' toggles.

global_layout.mobile: Single column. Top sticky header with 'Vista Previa' (Preview) button that opens a bottom Sheet containing the LiveCardPreview.
global_layout.desktop: Two columns: Editor on the left (max-w-md), sticky PhoneFrame preview on the right.
global_layout.spacing: Generous padding: p-4 to p-6 inside cards to prevent mis-taps by users with larger thumbs.

header.elements: Back arrow, Page Title ('Editar Tarjeta'), 'Vista Previa' button (Eye Icon)
header.behavior: Sticky top, z-50, backdrop-blur-md bg-white/90 border-b border-slate-200

public_link_section.style: Rounded-xl card, bg-white p-4 border border-slate-200 mb-6

components_to_use.Accordion: Use shadcn accordion to group the 5 steps. Keep visual clutter low.
components_to_use.Collapsible: Use for 'Ver opciones avanzadas' inside each accordion content block.
components_to_use.Sheet: Use for the Mobile Phone Preview. Triggered by 'Vista Previa' button in the sticky header. The Sheet should slide up from the bottom (side='bottom') and take up 90% of the screen height, rendering the existing PhoneFrame.
components_to_use.Tabs: Use shadcn Tabs for top-level navigation: Diseño · QR · Reseñas · Métricas. Render as flat pills to look like segmented controls.
components_to_use.Card: Use flat shadcn cards with rounded-2xl and light border for inputs inside accordions.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement this strictly for mobile-first. The user must not feel overwhelmed. Heavy reliance on Shadcn Accordion for steps. The most important innovation here is taking the Phone Preview OUT of the natural scroll flow on mobile, placing it inside a Shadcn Bottom Sheet triggered by a sticky header button. Ensure input labels are large and use the friendly Spanish microcopy provided. Use tailwind 'rounded-2xl' for cards and 'p-4' spacing for large touch targets.
